verzen.tekst: Then the righteous man will stand in great boldness
verzen.html: Then the righteous man will stand in great boldness

verzen.tekst: When they see him, they will be troubled with terrible fear,
verzen.html: When they see him, they will be troubled with terrible fear,

verzen.tekst: They will speak amongst themselves repenting,
verzen.html: They will speak amongst themselves repenting,

verzen.tekst: We fools considered his life madness,
verzen.html: We fools considered his life madness,

verzen.tekst: How was he counted amongst sons of God?
verzen.html: How was he counted amongst sons of God?

verzen.tekst: Truly we went astray from the way of truth.
verzen.html: Truly we went astray from the way of truth.

verzen.tekst: We took our fill of the paths of lawlessness and destruction.
verzen.html: We took our fill of the paths of lawlessness and destruction.

verzen.tekst: What did our arrogance profit us?
verzen.html: What did our arrogance profit us?

verzen.tekst: Those things all passed away as a shadow,
verzen.html: Those things all passed away as a shadow,

verzen.tekst: like a ship passing through the billowy water,
verzen.html: like a ship passing through the billowy water,

verzen.tekst: Or it is like when a bird flies through the air,
verzen.html: Or it is like when a bird flies through the air,

verzen.tekst: Or it is like when an arrow is shot at a mark,
verzen.html: Or it is like when an arrow is shot at a mark,

verzen.tekst: So we also, as soon as we were born, ceased to be;
verzen.html: So we also, as soon as we were born, ceased to be;

verzen.tekst: Because the hope of the ungodly man is like chaff carried by the wind,
verzen.html: Because the hope of the ungodly man is like chaff carried by the wind,

verzen.tekst: But the righteous live forever.
verzen.html: But the righteous live forever.

verzen.tekst: Therefore they will receive the crown of royal dignity
verzen.html: Therefore they will receive the crown of royal dignity

verzen.tekst: He will take his zeal as complete armour,
verzen.html: He will take his zeal as complete armour,

verzen.tekst: He will put on righteousness as a breastplate,
verzen.html: He will put on righteousness as a breastplate,

verzen.tekst: He will take holiness as an invincible shield.
verzen.html: He will take holiness as an invincible shield.

verzen.tekst: He will sharpen stern wrath for a sword.
verzen.html: He will sharpen stern wrath for a sword.

verzen.tekst: Shafts of lightning will fly with true aim.
verzen.html: Shafts of lightning will fly with true aim.

verzen.tekst: Hailstones full of wrath will be hurled as from a catapult.
verzen.html: Hailstones full of wrath will be hurled as from a catapult.

verzen.tekst: A mighty wind will encounter them.
verzen.html: A mighty wind will encounter them.
